feature: current-head sanitizer validation for trusted launcher and scanner paths
observations: KASAN and KCSAN/lockdep images booted and passed the trusted launcher and scanner selftests without sanitizer or lockdep markers.
The original two-vCPU KASAN run at 256 fuzz iterations produced repeated RCU stall diagnostics under TCG and was terminated; it was not reported as a pass.
A bounded one-vCPU KASAN run at 16 iterations completed cleanly.
limitations: The available environment uses QEMU TCG rather than hardware acceleration; high-iteration sanitizer timing is not representative of production hardware.
The current evidence does not qualify physical hardware, KVM, or a full 256-iteration KASAN run on a production-class host.
ACPI AML timeout messages are present in QEMU logs but are unrelated to FAISAL code paths and are not treated as clean-hardware evidence.
